posts.author: Snake Logan
posts.title: Re: Idea about Experiment....
posts.edited: Last Edit: Today at 11:46:08 AM by Snake Logan
posts.html:
In short, the exploit allows people to upload any file to anywhere on the machine.

From a GMod perspective - You could put a lua script to make everyone who connects download the entire contents of the gamemode folder.

Non-GMod perspective - You could upload a malicious executable into the computers startup folder, potentially allowing someone to seize control of the server.

The exploit also allows you to delete files from the target machine, so someone could quite happily destroy the operating system and render the machine useless for a time.
